protocol: Same160k EMA warm start and seed90;80 steps per variant. Throughput uses windows21-40 and41-60, excluding compilation and profiler window61-70. No scientific checkpoints produced.

validation.cache_tensor_equality: 20 GPU batches: reorder, duplicates, missing IDs and double-buffer reuse, exact FP32 equality
validation.loss_comparison: Sync/async rounded FM and REPA losses agree through60 steps; final FM window differs by0.0001. This is not a claim of bitwise-identical training trajectories.
validation.cache_only_repa: Fixed outer wrapper returning zero when image=None despite a valid feature cache. Both REPA profiles include this fix.
validation.fullgraph: Guided run completed80 training steps with fullgraph=True. No graph-break fallback allowed.

decisions.repa_prefetch: Enabled by default for cache-backed positive-weight REPA; independent CUDA stream, two pinned host buffers, DMA events and consumer record_stream.
decisions.pattern_matcher: Keep legacy default; enabling it alone did not improve speed.
decisions.guided_compile: Opt-in for long fixed-shape runs; higher initial compilation cost and memory. Benchmark is short, not long-run/eval-transition validation.
decisions.std_sampling: Reuse clean condition already copied by condition assembly.
decisions.profiler: Single bounded capture; CUDA kernel time excludes duplicate CPU-side aggregates.
